+"""Safe loading of images referenced by user-settable strings.
+
+The backend never sends an HTTP request to an address a user can set (that
+would be SSRF). A reference is resolved in one of three ways only:
+  * ``data:image`` URL  -> decoded locally
+  * storage object path -> read through the storage client
+  * URL under our own STORAGE_HOST -> mapped to its storage object path
+Any other http(s) URL (or other scheme) is refused and yields ``None``.
+"""
+import base64
+import re
+from typing import Optional
+from urllib.parse import unquote
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+
+_SCHEME = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.\-]*:")
+
+
+def storage_key(ref: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Return the storage object key for ``ref``, or None if it is not ours."""
+    ref = (ref or "").strip()
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").rstrip("/")
+    lower = ref.lower()
+    if lower.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
+        if not host or not lower.startswith(host.lower() + "/"):
+            return None
+        key = ref[len(host) + 1:]
+    elif ref.startswith("//") or _SCHEME.match(ref):
+        return None  # other schemes (file:, ftp:, ...) or scheme-relative URLs
+    else:
+        key = ref
+    if "?" in key or "#" in key or "\\" in key:
+        return None
+    key = key.lstrip("/")
+    if not key or any(seg in ("", ".", "..") for seg in unquote(key).split("/")):
+        return None
+    return key
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(ref: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Load image bytes from a data: URL or our storage; never from the network."""
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    if ref.startswith("data:image"):
+        try:
+            _, encoded = ref.split(",", 1)
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded)
+        except Exception:
+            return None
+    key = storage_key(ref)
+    if key is None:
+        return None
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    return storage.download_image(key)
